name: Splitglass
tagline: Your Apple Watch workout, on the glass in front of you.
description: A live heads-up display for an Apple Watch workout. Heart rate, heart-rate zone, time in zone, distance, pace, energy and elapsed time all come from HealthKit on the watch, so the numbers are identical on a treadmill and on a road, and the zones are your own zones out of Health -- the same boundaries and the same accumulated time the Fitness app shows. Set a plan on the phone and the glasses count down each split or interval, with the pace band to hold. Outdoors, a breadcrumb map draws the track you have run, your heading on it, and an optional GPX route to follow. Long press for Lap, screen, units and plan controls; the left temple steps back through screens and the right steps forward.
author: Will Grannis

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Receives live workout readings from the Splitglass iPhone app, either directly on the device or through the splitglass.grannis.xyz relay.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Draws the breadcrumb map for outdoor workouts and reports how far you are from a loaded route. Never used for indoor workouts, and never sent anywhere.
